writeup: TIC 219800831 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 36.8877 days. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 0.14% dimming, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 38.5 using automated light-curve analysis. Pixel-level imaging confirms a peak signal-to-noise of 22.1, though the centroid offset of 16.0 arcsec from the target warrants consideration in follow-up observations. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. This candidate does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate. The automated machine-learning screening assigned it a score of 0.78 out of 1.0, indicating a reasonably high likelihood of being a true eclipsing system.
